face_convention: N/E/S/W are the cube's side contacts with the module turned exactly as drawn in its raw_orig_icon (rotation 0).

elements.name: block_001

pinout.source: src/model/catalogue.ts:r2k2-o (prior pass; its rotation 0 is Приложение 2's drawing, not necessarily this icon's)

elements.notes: Icon has the same fan-out as block_003 (lead to W, body, then lines from the far lead to N, E and S), and block_003's pinout is confirmed as a W–E resistor with E wired to N and S. So this is very likely the same T topology, and the catalogue's plain W–E span is incomplete.

elements.name: block_002

pinout.source: src/model/catalogue.ts:r12k-a (prior pass; its rotation 0 is Приложение 2's drawing, not necessarily this icon's)

elements.notes: Read the way block_003's confirmed icon reads (every line that reaches the rim is a contact), this icon shows a plain wire straight across W–E with the resistor hanging off it down to the bottom rim — i.e. W and E joined, resistor from that node to S. Doesn't match the catalogue's N–E hypothesis in this orientation; needs confirming.

elements.name: block_003
elements.notes: Electrically W is one node and N/E/S are one node, with the resistor between them, so it can be used straight through (W–E) or as a corner (W–N, W–S). The small ring on a stem under the resistor body is unexplained; it may be what distinguishes this from the kit's other 68 кОм module (SPEC.md lists two: r68k-o and r68k-a, one each). num_in_kit = 1 assumes this icon is only one of those two.
